short_summary: Create a virtual machine and its supporting network resources.
long_summary: Provision an Azure virtual machine in the specified resource group along with the supporting virtual network, subnet, network security group, and network interface in a single orchestrated call. The VM size, administrator credentials, and target location must all be provided. Resource names supplied for `--virtual-network-name`, `--network-security-group-name`, and `--network-interface-name` are created if they do not already exist in the resource group.

examples.short_summary: Create a Linux VM in East US
examples.command: az vm create --name myvm --resource-group myrg --location eastus --vm-size Standard_D2s_v5 --admin-username azureuser --admin-password 'P@ssw0rd123!' --network-interface-name myvm-nic --virtual-network-name myvm-vnet --network-security-group-name myvm-nsg --subscription-id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
